Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the search results and incorrectly stated that Thailand was the host of the 2020 AFC U-23 Championship qualification (confusing the final tournament host with the qualification hosts). This flawed premise skewed the boundary-country reasoning and ultimately led to an incorrect wood answer, later compounded by an unsupported reinterpretation of “mostly produced” to select gurjan instead of the widely attested Burma teak.
